safety_verdicts.content: Patient works as a housekeeper in a hotel and changed jobs 4 months ago.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated captures hotel housekeeper work but does not include the Gold detail that she changed jobs 4 months ago.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that she changed jobs 4 months ago removes a useful temporal clue linking onset/worsening of hand dermatitis to a new workplace environment/exposure, which could affect counseling on trigger avoidance and occupational history. However, the core clinical issue (likely contact dermatitis from cleaning products with poor glove use) and initial management (gloves, emollients, topical steroid, follow-up) are still supported by the remaining history.
